title: Glokzin Teal Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Tempered Glass, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf with integrated towel bar for bathroom organization: 16 inches x 5 inches (16-inch, 16 in) tempered, beveled-edge glass vanity shelf with 3/8-in (0.38 in) thick glass and solid brass hardware — available in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Use as a bathroom wall shelf over a vanity for toiletries and décor, plus a towel bar/towel rack/towel holder below for hand towels. Wall mount / wall-mounted installation with included hardware (glass shelf and all installation hardware); screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Traditional styling that fits transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware, ideal for matching Waverly Place collection looks and grooved bathroom hardware themes. Weight capacity 2 lb. Corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection.
